blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The Supreme Court (SC) has upheld the constitutionality of Republic Act No. (RA) 12326, affirming the extension of terms of office for barangay officials and Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) members to five years and scheduling the next Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE) for November 2028. In a decision written by now Chief Justice Rodil V. Zalameda, the SC dismissed the petition filed by election lawyer Romulo B. Macalintal, who challenged the law’s validity. Enacted on September 24, 2026, RA 12326 increased the term length of barangay leaders from four to five years—revising the previous law, RA 12232, passed in 2025—while […]...
